overview_description.description: Refortif AI develops software for securing artificial intelligence models and automating hardware design workflows. The company offers a model weight obfuscation tool that protects proprietary machine learning weights at deployment time, enforcing security controls and digital rights management. Its technology keeps original model parameters hidden during runtime, including in untrusted edge, cloud, or partner environments. Refortif AI also builds Atrisa, an AI-driven assistant that helps engineers design, debug, and simulate analog circuits. Atrisa provides an agentic workflow for analog design by drafting schematics, editing circuit topologies, and running simulations based on engineer prompts. These offerings serve teams working in cybersecurity, AI deployment, semiconductor design, and electronic design automation.
